basic_details.job_title: District Raigarh Sports Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Raigarh has announced 4 temporary Sports Teacher vacancies for posting in Dharamjaigarh. Candidates can apply offline by sending their application by registered post or submitting it to the Assistant Commissioner, Tribal Development District Raigarh (Chhattisgarh) on or before 17 November 2026 during office hours. Applicants must be a Graduate with B.P.Ed and a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh, with an age of minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years. qualification.details: Educational and Professional Qualification: Applicants must hold a Graduation degree and a Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed). | Residency Condition: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh. | Age Limit: Minimum age is 21 years and maximum age is 35 years as on the date of eligibility rules. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules regarding age limits.

selection_process: The selection is based on marks obtained in selection criteria and criteria weighting as follows:

Graduation marks percentage: 40% weightage. B.P.Ed professional qualification marks percentage: 25% weightage. NIS / M.P.Ed qualification: 10 marks. Experience in a government institution: 15 marks. State-level sports participant: 5 marks / National-level sports participant: 10 marks. (If marks are equal
the candidate with higher age will be selected).
The selection committee's decision is final and binding. The post is completely temporary
and there is no provision for regularization in government service.
important_instructions: Applicants must be permanent residents of Chhattisgarh. Applications must be sent via registered post. Direct office submissions will not be accepted. Applications must reach the office by 17 November 2026 within office hours. The position is temporary and offers no right to regularization in government service. Enclose self-attested copies of educational certificates, sports certificates, domicile, caste certificate, PAN card, and SBI passbook first page with a pasted photograph.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through registered post or delivered directly to the designated office. Applications sent directly to the office will not be accepted. The postal address to send the application is: Karyalay Sahayak Aayukt, Adivasi Vikas, Jila - Raigarh (Chhatisgarh) Envelope requirements: Candidates must send the prescribed application along with self-attested copies of required degree/diploma, experience certificate, sports participation certificate, domicile certificate, caste certificate issued by a competent authority, mobile number, current address, first page of State Bank of India passbook (with passport-size photo pasted), and PAN card photocopy. Applications received after the last date (17 November 2026 during office hours) will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in District Raigarh Sports Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 temporary Sports Teacher vacancies available under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by registered post is 17 November 2026 during office hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Sports Teacher post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree (UG) along with a Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) professional qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years, subject to government age relaxation rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 40,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent offline via registered post or submitted through the designated postal channel to the Assistant Commissioner, Tribal Development District Raigarh.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be permanent residents of Chhattisgarh and fulfill the required educational and age criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the position is completely temporary, and working in this post does not grant eligibility for regularization in government service.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for the Sports Teacher position?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic graduation marks, B.P.Ed marks, NIS/M.P.Ed qualifications, government institution experience, and participation in state or national level sports.
